title: Trips
lead: Every journey in the selected period. Search, filter and export the result in the Journey Log format, for example as a logbook of private and business trips.

filter.place: Showing trips that start or end at {{place}}.
filter.placeUnknown: The linked place does not exist in this period. Places are recalculated from the selected period, so the link may be outdated.

notice.title_one: {{count}} trip looks like a faulty recording.
notice.body_one: It is left out of the analyses until you have looked at it and decided.
notice.body_other: They are left out of the analyses until you have looked at them and decided.

issue.lowConsumption: Consumption {{value}}. Below {{limit}} is not possible for a Polestar; usually the recording is missing energy.
issue.lowConsumptionSoc: No energy reported. Estimated from the state of charge it is at most {{value}}; below {{limit}} is not possible.
issue.longDuration: Duration {{duration}}. A single trip longer than 24 hours usually missed its end.
issue.odometerMismatch: The odometer says {{odometer}}, the trip says {{distance}}.
issue.socGain: The state of charge rises by {{gain}} points during the trip.

state.excluded: Excluded. The trip stays stored and stays excluded, even when a later export contains it again.
